# Is Claude down?

Updated November 25, 2026 · an explainer, not a live status page

**This page can't tell you whether Claude is down right now**: it is a static page. The answer is on Anthropic's official status page:

- [status.claude.com](https://status.claude.com)

Anthropic's status page (status.anthropic.com leads there too) shows claude.ai, the Claude API and Claude's other services, with current incidents and their history.

## If the status page says everything is fine

Then the problem is probably closer to you. In order, try:

1. Another network: switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data, or turn off a VPN.

2. Signing out and in again, or closing and reopening the Claude app.

3. Updating the app, or trying Claude on the web from another device.

4. A shorter message: a very long conversation or file can fail when a short one works.

5. Waiting a few minutes: many problems are short and don't reach the status page.

## If Claude is down

An outage usually affects one maker at a time. Another maker's model can carry on in the meantime: in Omnimo you can switch from Claude to GPT-6, Gemini, Grok or DeepSeek in the same chat, and on supported devices Apple Intelligence answers on the device with no internet at all.

To be clear about what this does and doesn't fix: Omnimo reaches Anthropic's models through an API. When Anthropic's API is down, Claude in Omnimo can be down too; the other makers' models are not affected. When only the Claude app or website is down, the API often still works. [Claude in Omnimo](https://www.privateslm.dev/models/claude-sonnet.html).

## Questions

### How do I know if Claude is down?

Check Anthropic's official status page, listed on this page. It shows current incidents for Claude and its API.

### What can I use while Claude is down?

Another maker's model. In Omnimo you can switch to GPT-6, Gemini, Grok or DeepSeek in the same chat; on a device with Apple Intelligence, it answers on the device without the internet.
